## Description

Hold button 3 s → LED pulses → companion shows 4-digit code that must match the clip's LED pattern → mic self-test ("say testing") → pair to the doctor (DEVICE_PAIRING valid 90 days). Clip becomes selectable at consent (A-02).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Pairing requires explicit code confirmation; mismatches abort and are logged.
- [ ] **AC2.** Pairing expires after 90 days and requires re-pairing.
- [ ] **AC3.** Self-test failure blocks pairing with guidance.
- [ ] **AC4.** Paired clip appears in A-02 device list with battery and firmware.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
